v2.4.0 — UPGRADES & UNITS
The changelog now lives in this panel instead of a wall of text over the title screen. Classic combat drones are back, with a separate kamikaze drone. ALL plasma re-arms now come from Plasma Weapons research — ground AND aircraft swap to plasma (no longer at the Fusion Age). Superhumans are blisteringly fast, dirt-cheap & laser-armed. The production menu highlights upgraded units and the exact changed stat — batch size, 0 MP, plasma arms — in green, and building-driven upgrades (Drone Assembly batch) refresh instantly.

v2.3.0 — CITIES & ORDNANCE
Cities are now a sprawl of individually-destructible districts (power plants · factories · airbases spread within) — knocked out piece by piece; nearby cities fuse into a MEGACITY; losing a city guts its defenders. Ground units on a slope erect a small foundation pad. Plasma turrets/units & missiles lead moving targets. Tactical missiles are smaller, trail cloud & hit local. FILL has LOW/MID/HIGH height levels & the build menu shows DIG costs. Influence is cheaper. Standard ballistic missiles need no uranium.

v2.2.0 — ARSENAL EXPANSION
Railgun battlecruiser + bigger ships · Barracks · Underground Airwing (replaces lost aircraft) · Tractor Beam (deorbits & burns orbital enemies) · Orbital Strike Fighters (need a Space Station) · Laser Planes + laser PD on jets/ships · Nanite Foundry (heal radius + smart-round nanites + faster digging) · lasers dim with altitude · nukes mushroom low / plasma-ball high · satellites shatter in place · cloning faster · unarmored units die fast · shapeshifters = global regen + fast infantry.

v2.1.0 — GROUND & FLEET
Ground units now ADVANCE to engage the nearest threat · SAM reaches the mesosphere · arcing shots lead moving targets · Superhumans fly with a reflect energy-shield & intercept air · land reclamation (fill water→land) + choose dig depth · Aircraft Carriers (free fighter wings) + Arsenal missile ships + cheap Orbital Frigates · distinct Scout sprite.

v2.0.0 — SPECIAL ECONOMY
15 special-resource buildings (psionic relay · cloning · deep-ore · gene · uranium enrichment · drone assembly · data center · antimatter extractor · ammo depot · droid foundry · space station · mass-driver railway · munition · superconductor · mantle forge) carry your power — research gives smaller flat buffs and unlocks the buildings instead · uranium gates nukes + a ballistic strike · antimatter feeds an antimatter strike & dreadnoughts.

v1.9.9 — AIRBURST & ARSENAL
Strikes can hit the air (nukes airburst · reticle snaps to airborne enemies) · lasers/psionics fire into the sky · plasma reworked into fast flat self-steering bolts · aircraft scream across the map & intercept beyond visual range · no-shield units get dumpstered · War Walkers fire a sky-reaching laser · factories garrison combined arms · dev console (type 1 2 3 4 5 E).

v1.9.8 — FLEET & FORGE
Bigger/taller world · 5 new autodrone enemy types · satellites launch to orbit on a rocket (or railgun once Space Age) · real lobbed plasma weapons · base units re-arm with plasma past the Fusion Age · cyberpunk buildings · Research Labs make research faster/cheaper.

v1.9.7 — COMBAT OVERHAUL
Enemies plunge from orbit in a vulnerable re-entry state then turn hostile · atmosphere-layer combat (ground AA altitude-capped) · enemy interceptors duel your aircraft · orbital barrage hurls the earth & guts anchored buildings · friendly HP rebalanced so combat is decisive.

FIELD MANUAL

// HOW TO COMMAND — AND WHERE · click a section to expand

⚡ QUICK START — YOUR FIRST FIVE MINUTES

1. Open the ECON tab (bottom-left build bar): place a Power Plant + Housing Block, then a Comms Tower — stability feeds your INFLUENCE, and influence pays for everything political.
2. PROD tab: a Factory and an extra Airbase. Then press the pulsing PRODUCE button (top bar) and queue tanks, AA & interceptors.
3. Press RESEARCH and queue a few techs — they auto-start as influence accrues.
4. DEF tab: line your cities with turrets and plant a Missile Silo — fire it later via ☢ STRIKE.
5. Watch the T-timer (top right). When the fleet hits, hold every city. Lose them all — or hit 0 stability — and it's over.

🕹 CONTROLS — DESKTOP & TOUCH

Desktop: ← → / A D scroll the front · W S / ↑ ↓ or Shift+wheel pan the tall sky · wheel zooms toward the cursor (or the + − ⌂ buttons) · click selects · right-click / Esc cancels anything · SPACE pauses · M toggles music · click or drag the minimap to jump the camera.
Touch: drag to scroll · pinch to zoom · tap to select / place / designate · long-press to cancel · strategic strikes take a first tap to AIM, then a ☢ CONFIRM tap to fire — no fat-finger nukes. Zoomed in? The camera can reach the whole world — pan speed matches what your eye sees at any zoom.

① ECONOMY — IC · MANPOWER · STABILITY → INFLUENCE

IND. CAP builds everything. MANPOWER crews it. INFLUENCE buys research & raises your army cap — and it flows from STABILITY alone: the higher your stability, the faster influence accrues.

Stability climbs slowly toward your STABILITY CAP (shown as cur / cap up top). Buildings don't grant stability directly — Comms Towers, Propaganda Bureaus & Radar raise the CAP it can reach. Stability falls when cities burn, you over-use strikes, or run dystopian/psionic doctrine; dangerous research adds a temporary ⚠ unrest that recovers on its own. At 0 stability you lose — watch it like a fuel gauge.

② PRODUCE UNITS & ✈ AIR COMMAND

Build a Factory / Airbase / Shipyard / Space Center, then press PRODUCE (top bar) — units roll out of the matching building. Researched doctrines add whole new rosters here.

✈ AIR COMMAND: every crewed FIXED-WING aircraft needs a hangar slot — Airbase +6, Underground Airwing +3, Aero Works +4. Drones are exempt (swarm away) and carrier wings support themselves. A bigger air force means more air infrastructure — which the enemy can bomb.
🚁 ROTOR COMMAND: HELICOPTERS are their own arm — they draw a SEPARATE pool (not hangar slots), need no runway, and base out of Heli-Depots +6 and every CITY (+3 each). They hug the deck: a heli hovers over its target pounding it with rockets, but physically cannot climb to high-altitude enemies — pure close air support. Rearm at any city, heli-depot, airbase, or carrier deck.
⬆ ORBITAL LIFT works the same for space units: each Space Center / Station provides lift that your orbital fleet reserves. Locked cards tell you exactly what they need — research, a production-line building, a resource deposit, lift or hangar space.

③ RESEARCH & DOCTRINES

Press RESEARCH and spend INFLUENCE on the tech tree. Doctrines unlock whole armies — drones, androids, psionics, superhumans — plus the ★ superweapons. Click several nodes to queue them; they auto-start as influence arrives. Research Labs make research faster & cheaper. Hover a node to see the full prerequisite path light up.

④ ☢ STRATEGIC STRIKES

Build a Missile Silo (DEF tab), then press ☢ STRIKE, choose a weapon and click the battlefield. Launch sites are marked ▲. Conventional strikes (Heavy Guided Missile, Kinetic Lance, Micromissile Barrage, Combat Drop) cost only IC and a short reload — call them the moment a line breaks. Only the genuinely unthinkable — Nuclear, Cluster MIRV, Firestorm, Antimatter Strike, Mind-Forge — spend STABILITY, your political capital for crossing that line. The reticle snaps to air fleets for airbursts; on touch, tap to aim then hit ☢ CONFIRM.

⑤ SPECIAL RESOURCES

Build Extractors on the glowing deposits. Owning Steel / Oil / Rare Earth permanently cheapens its matching unit category (ground / air & naval / space); Uranium additionally softens both the IC and stability cost of every strike — they decide everything late-game. Some tech & weapons (Nuclear, Mind-Forge) require specific deposits.

⑥ ★ SUPERWEAPONS & THE MIND-FORGE

Superweapons (Colossus, Titan, Telekinetic Pylon, Dreadnought…) are built from PRODUCE once researched. The MIND-FORGE plasma lance appears in ☢ STRIKE once you have Antimatter + Telekinesis researched and own Uranium.

⊕ FIRE CONTROL — HAND-AIM YOUR HEAVY GUNS

Heavy emplacements (Bunker, Laser Tower, Orbital Gun, Mass Driver, Microrocket Battery, Particle Cannon) can be hand-directed. 1) Select the gun → press ⊕ ADD TO FIRE CONTROL in its info panel. 2) Click enemies inside the radar ring to mark them. 3) The gun PRIORITIZES your marks — save that railgun round for a tungsten rod, not chaff. Add more guns to build a battery on one radar. A gun in Fire Control always hits what you designate first; with nothing marked in reach it still defends on its own, so it's never idle. Right-click / Esc / long-press releases.

⑦ BUILDINGS & THEIR COSTS

Every structure costs IC + MANPOWER plus a small INFLUENCE authorization. Burying a building costs more but shields it (deep tunnels resist assault). As the ages advance your buildings take on a cyberpunk neon look.
